MAINTAINER ATTESTATION (Damian Betebenner, 2026-09-02): SGPstateData is AUTHORITATIVE for these cut scores. Its Indiana values were derived from IDOE documents and used operationally in production SGP analyses; much of that source documentation is no longer retrievable on the public web. A missing URL is therefore a documentation gap, not a provenance defect. See wiki/sources/sgpstatedata-operational-provenance.md.

comparability.notes: Continuous ISTEP+ administration on the 2015 scale.

MATHEMATICS.notes: Three-level ISTEP+ scheme observed in Indiana_Data_LONG$ACHIEVEMENT_LEVEL for 2015–2018.

3.notes: Observed LOSS/HOSS endpoints of SCALE_SCORE in the Indiana operational LONG for YEAR <= 2018, confirmed by the maintainer 2026-09-02 as the ISTEP / ISTEP+ lowest and highest obtainable scale scores. Consistent with SGP::SGPstateData[['IN']][['Achievement']][['Knots_Boundaries']] loss.hoss_10 = c(100, 400) for the grade-10 scale, which is shared across eras. See wiki/sources/sgpstatedata-operational-provenance.md. Designated official by the maintainer 2026-09-02: these are the loss/hoss values of record for Indiana historical copula analysis (ADR-014).

notes: ISTEP+ three-level scheme (Did Not Pass / Pass / Pass +) after the 2015 college-and-career-ready standards reset. ISTEP / ISTEP+ / ILEARN tested grades start at 3. The filed-not-fixed grade-encoding-split analysis (K vs 0) does not apply. Grade 10 ISTEP+ ELA/Mathematics appear in 2017–2018; those cuts are on a separate hundreds-scale (not the 3–8 scale).
